current_answer: OpenAI plugins are installable packages of skills, tool connections or both; the universal directory distributes them for supported hosts, not universal execution or access. Current public-ZIP guidance excludes lifecycle hooks and registered MCP server mappings (apps / .app.json). Local support or optionality does not establish public eligibility: choose a bounded local scope, a separately useful public candidate without excluded components, or stop/redesign/clarify. The separate public option is unimplemented; conversion guidance has an unresolved submission-context hook tension.
